sources.label: NAUR FRU guide (P2 intro: Quadruple Slap)

steps.title: Pick up the Usurper, party around her
steps.cue: Usurper of Frost appears in the centre
steps.rule: Quadruple Slap is a two-hit buster on the main tank that leaves a vulnerability. Melee take her flanks; healers and ranged stand behind her, about 8m south of the centre.

MainTank.rule: Tank her 4m north of the centre, facing her away from the party. Invuln as the first slap's cast finishes so it covers both hits.

OffTank.rule: Stand next to the main tank. Provoke right after the second slap lands, so the next auto doesn't hit the main tank through the vulnerability.
